import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

np.random.seed(42)

# Load training data
with open("./input/train/train.json", "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)
train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)

# Load test data
with open("./input/test/test.json", "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Text columns for vectorization
text_cols = ["request_text_edit_aware", "request_title"]

# Combine text into single document per row
X_train_text = train_df[text_cols].astype(str).agg(" ".join, axis=1)
X_test_text = test_df[text_cols].astype(str).agg(" ".join, axis=1)

# TF-IDF vectorizer fitted only on training data
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=5000)
X_train_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_test_text)

# Identify common numeric columns between train and test (FIXED: Convert to list)
train_cols = set(train_df.columns)
test_cols = set(test_df.columns)
common_cols = train_cols.intersection(test_cols)
numeric_cols = [
    col
    for col in common_cols
    if col in train_df.select_dtypes(include="number").columns
]
X_train_num = train_df[numeric_cols].values.astype(float).fillna(0)
X_test_num = test_df[numeric_cols].values.astype(float).fillna(0)

# Stack numeric and TF-IDF features
if len(numeric_cols) > 0:
    X_train_final = np.hstack([X_train_num, X_train_tfidf.toarray()])
    X_test_final = np.hstack([X_test_num, X_test_tfidf.toarray()])
else:
    X_train_final = X_train_tfidf.toarray()
    X_test_final = X_test_tfidf.toarray()

# Target variable
y_train = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].values.astype(float)

# PROPER VALIDATION SPLIT: Model trains ONLY on this subset
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_final, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train model ONLY on training split (NOT refit on validation)
model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=5,
    subsample=0.9,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    random_state=42,
)
model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

# Evaluate on truly unseen validation data
val_pred_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_split)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, val_pred_probs)

# Make predictions on test data
test_pred_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_final)[:, 1]

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Create and save submission file with correct format
request_ids = test_df["request_id"].values
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "request_id": request_ids,
        "requester_received_pizza": np.round(test_pred_probs, 6),
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Print ONLY the evaluation metric value
print(f"AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.4f}")
